finding: CodeRabbit actionable (same round), check_h4_provenance.py build_matcher: a bare `import log_parsing` caches by name in sys.modules, so the SECOND dataset (ts) silently reused the FIRST checkout's (hipster) parser. hipster/ts log_parsing.py are byte-identical today, so no walked result was wrong, but the checker was not bound to each dataset's own source.
remedy: load each checkout's log_parsing.py via importlib under a dataset-specific module name (nezha_logparse_{ns}).

mechanism_proof.old: both datasets' module.__file__ == checkout-hipster/log_parsing.py; same module object reused (is -> True)
mechanism_proof.new: hipster.__file__ == checkout-hipster/..., ts.__file__ == checkout-ts/...; distinct module objects
